resources.string: Enter text to translate, up to 4,000 characters.

Only text you ask to translate is sent through our translation server to Google\'s Gemini API. Under Google\'s free tier, content may be reviewed by people and used to improve its products. Please don\'t translate sensitive or confidential text. We don\'t save translation text or results. Our server stores total request counts to limit usage. No account or sign-in is needed.
No internet connection. Connect and try again.
Translation is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
That took too long. Try again.
Couldn\'t reach the translation service. Try again.
Got an unexpected response. Try again.
Your conversations, in any language. Translate a draft or read a copied message right above your keyboard.

Tap the translation icon to write, or the message icon to read a copy. Source language is detected automatically; English is the default target. Tap either language to change it. Indian languages include native-script and Roman options. Only explicit translation requests leave your phone.

Write: enter a private draft, choose languages, then Translate & insert. Read: copy a message, open the chat input, tap the message icon and confirm Translate. Selected editor text can be read through the translation icon. Compatible selection menus also offer LingoBoard Translate.
LingoBoard selected: open a chat input to translate above the keys. No overlay permission required.
Choose LingoBoard for translation above the keys. The optional floating mode can still work with another keyboard.
Floating translations could not start. Allow display over other apps and try again. This phone or app may restrict overlays.
Allow LingoBoard to display over other apps so the English result can float over your current app.
Reading session started. Return to your chat or game.
Floating translation is active. Tap Stop to end the session.
Open reading translation or translate copied text. Drag to move.
Message copied. Translate it to English?
No readable text message found. Copy a message and try again. Passwords, sensitive clips and your own translation results are skipped.
Shift on for one letter. Double tap for Caps Lock
This app did not share selected editor text. Copy the message and use Read instead.
Translation inserted. Review it before sending.
The chat cursor changed or insertion was unavailable. Review the result and tap Insert here, or copy it.
Open the chat input with LingoBoard to read this message. Available for 60 seconds.
Learned words cleared from this device.
